system.description:
You extend your shadow to a point that you can see within 60 feet of you. All Creatures in a 15-foot cube originating from this point, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are grabbed by dozens of shadowy hands taking 5d6 bludgeoning or necrotic damage and are Shadow Bound for the duration. Creatures make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this condition, or half as much on a success and no further effects.

Creatures that end their turn Shadow Bound by this jutsu takes 3d6 bludgeoning or necrotic damage.

Bright. Increase the size of the Cube by +5 feet.

Dimly Lit.. Creatures that fail their saving throw are disarmed as the shadows pulls them apart from their weapons. Disarmed weapons are bound to the ground and requires an Athletics check vs your jutsu save DC to pick up, for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the initial damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage dealt at the end of a creatures turn by 1d6.
